description: This file defines the interface for a logging system used in firmware, including classes for buffered console output, related functions for logging, and external references for initialization and message handling.

classes.name: Logging
classes.description: A class managing buffered logging with support for multiple constructors, buffer management, and append operations.

classes.name: LoggingWithStorage
classes.description: A subclass of Logging that includes a default buffer for storage.

methods.description: Initializes the Logging object with default values.

methods.description: Default constructor for Logging.
